record.name: Telegram
record.one_liner: Telegram provides public APIs including the Bot API, Telegram API (MTProto), TDLib, and Gateway API for building bots, customized clients, and verification workflows.

auth.notes: Bot API uses bot tokens/api_id and api_hash for client authorization.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for Telegram and obtain an API id from my.telegram.org.

api_surface.notes: The Bot API communicates via a simple HTTPS interface, and TDLib provides cross-platform client libraries.

buildability.reasoning: Self-service credentials can be obtained via my.telegram.org and the Bot API / MTProto API are documented.

evidence.claim: Telegram offers the Bot API, Telegram API and TDLib, and the Gateway API free of charge.
Developers can sign up and go to my.telegram.org under API development tools to obtain an api_id and api_hash.
